Overview

One clear view of patient waits, operational bottlenecks and next actions.

What SlotSwap does

A practical prototype for the hospital operations problem.

OPERATIONS

Find cases waiting substantially longer than the typical wait for their department and triage group.

PREDICTION

Estimate wait time from historical patterns using a transparent category-based baseline in this browser demo.

Wait-time estimator

A working, data-driven baseline using observed averages from the loaded dataset. This single-file web version does not run the Python Random Forest.

How the estimator works

Transparent baseline to keep the web demo usable without a Python server.

METHOD

Historical group median

Uses the median observed wait for matching department and triage. If no exact group exists, it falls back to the department median, then the overall median.

MODEL EVALUATION
Calculating…

Held-out evaluation of this browser baseline. MAE is the average absolute error in minutes. This is not the Random Forest score.

Dataset status

This build includes a snapshot of the supplied CSVs. You can replace a dataset with a local CSV upload.

Load your own CSVs

CSV files are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to a server by this static app.

Data quality and transparency

Wait time is read from the supplied encounter records. Department and triage categories are used for operational comparison. No appointment slot, doctor assignment, or live capacity is fabricated. The included CSVs are a demo snapshot and may be synthetic.

SlotSwap · Datathon Health Track · Local single-file web prototype · Not for clinical decisions.
